findings.title: If Apple sends you a push notification alerting you to a spyware attack, take it seriously
findings.summary_md: TechCrunch reported on August 13, 2026, that Apple had begun pushing lock-screen and Settings warnings for mercenary spyware targets, describing the notifications as high-confidence alerts that should be taken very seriously. The article explained that Apple does not identify the spyware family or attacker behind individual alerts, and recommended enabling Lockdown Mode and contacting Access Now for help.

findings.title: Apple sends new 'Threat Notification' alerts over mercenary spyware attacks
findings.summary_md: BleepingComputer confirmed on August 13, 2026, that Apple sent a new batch of threat notifications to targeted users in 110 countries, separate from the August wave covered later. The report cited Apple stating that the attacks cost millions of dollars, are highly sophisticated, and are aimed at a very small number of high-profile individuals such as journalists, activists, and diplomats.
